steps.name: phase1_implement
steps.instruction:
Before acting, honor the memory hint that will be appended to this message — search fleet-memory for operational context keyed to this workflow type.

Implement the following task in repo {{input.Repo}}. When done, open a PR against main.

Task:
  Issue number: {{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}}
  Description: {{input.Description | default: 'none'}}

Branch name: Use `{{input.BranchName}}` if it is provided and non-empty. Otherwise, auto-generate: use `feat/issue-{{input.IssueNumber}}` if an issue number is provided, or a short `feat/<description-slug>` for description-only tasks.

IMPORTANT: If an issue number is provided, always fetch the latest issue details before starting — run `gh issue view {{input.IssueNumber}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --comments` as your first step and use THAT content as your spec.

At the end of your response, output the PR URL on its own line:
PR_URL: https://github.com/{{input.Repo}}/pull/NNN

Then output the PR head commit you pushed, on its own line (from `gh pr view <PR> --repo {{input.Repo}} --json headRefOid`):
HEAD_SHA: <40-hex commit sha>
Preserve the existing branch/PR and all verified work. Check gh pr list --head {{input.BranchName}} first; never open a duplicate. DO NOT BLOCK ON CI INSIDE YOUR TURN: push, then report. End with IMPLEMENTATION: complete|incomplete, PR_URL: <real URL>, HEAD_RANGE: <head before this turn>..<new head>, and HEAD_SHA: <40 lowercase hex>, one line each. Incomplete work is not acceptance-ready.

vars.feedback: Complete all approved scope before returning IMPLEMENTATION: complete.

args.Subject: PR for issue #{{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}} in {{input.Repo}}
args.ReviewPrompt:
Review the PR in repo {{input.Repo}} that implements:
  Issue number: {{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}}
  Description: {{input.Description | default: 'none'}}

If an issue number is provided, run `gh issue view {{input.IssueNumber}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --comments` to read the full spec and verify the implementation matches.

Implementation summary from {{input.TargetAgent}}:
{{vars.impl_result}}

Prior consensus feedback (if any):
{{vars.consensus_out.ConsolidatedReasoning | default: 'none'}}

Merge-gate feedback review (if any):
{{vars.ceo_consensus_out.ConsolidatedReasoning | default: 'none'}}

Human review after merge-gate feedback (if any): {{vars.post_feedback_decision.Decision | default: 'none'}} — {{vars.post_feedback_decision.Comment | default: 'none'}}

Review discipline:
- Fetch the current spec/PR fresh — do NOT summarize prior rounds.
- Verify each prior finding against the current text before reporting.
- Give structured findings with severity (blocker, high, medium, low).
- End your response with exactly one verdict line: VERDICT: approved | changes_requested | needs_human_review.

EVIDENCE MIRROR (best-effort, optional).
Post your full technical review as a comment on that GitHub issue/PR, then put the resulting comment URL on your EVIDENCE: line.
- Before posting, remove private identities, internal IDs, hostnames, workflow-run identifiers, and private incident or configuration details. The repository may be public. Your unsanitized response is retained in durable workflow history regardless.
- If the GitHub CLI, auth, API, or the comment post fails for any reason, write `EVIDENCE: none`, mention the mirror failure in one short clause in SUMMARY:, and still return every BLOCKER: line and your VERDICT:. A failed mirror never downgrades or fails the review — durable history is the source of truth, the comment is a convenience copy.
- If you are continuing a response that was cut off and the earlier part already contains an `EVIDENCE: https://...` URL, reuse that URL and do NOT post a second comment.

PR head under review (ReviewRef): {{vars.head_sha | default: 'unknown'}}. Run `gh pr view {{vars.pr_url}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --json headRefOid` and request changes if the head differs from it.

Reviewed-ref attestation (#436):
- End your review with `REVIEWED_REF: <ref>` for the ref you actually checked.
- If `{{input.Repo}}` is public, check that no private names, internal URLs, hosts, credentials or private links are present, and add `PUBLIC_SCRUB: pass` or `PUBLIC_SCRUB: fail`.
ROUND SCOPE: round 1 reads gh issue view --json body,updatedAt and the full diff. Later rounds read prior blockers, the implementer summary and HEAD_RANGE commits only; re-read the issue only if updatedAt moved. Before the first approved verdict after round 1, do one FINAL AUDIT full-PR read, once per PR. Review exactly {{vars.H}}; a different current head is needs_human_review with BLOCKER: head_changed. A human pause decision is feedback, not attested approval.
Current HEAD_RANGE for this review (overrides an older implementation summary): {{vars.delta_review_range}}.

notifyStep.instruction: Notify the primary human that the PR needs an operational human review decision. Human approved returns to fresh exact-head consensus, never acceptance or merge. Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.

steps.name: notify_consensus_exhausted
steps.instruction: Five consensus rounds ended without an attested approval. Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.

steps.name: phase2_5_unresolved_check
steps.instruction: Read all unresolved review threads on {{vars.pr_url}}. Report only; never change code, branch or head. Return UNRESOLVED: none|open and verbatim threads. No open thread may be called resolved without evidence.

steps.name: pin
steps.instruction:
REQUIRE_ACCEPTANCE: {{vars.acceptance_mode}}
In off mode read only the actual gh headRefOid, EVERY page of check-runs and commit statuses for ci-rollup (zero/error is pending), and diff paths for change-class (deny list wins). Return HEAD_OID, CI and CHANGE_CLASS only. Skip issue-body hashing, design lookup, plan, receipts, prior rounds, owner and capability-map checks. Ignore all acceptance tokens even if present. Do not run acceptance work. The instructions below apply only in required mode.

Read-only PIN for {{input.Repo}}, issue {{input.IssueNumber}}, PR {{vars.pr_url}}; if URL absent, find the unique PR on {{input.BranchName}}. Use /opt/fleet/acceptance_plan.py and actual gh headRefOid. Collect EVERY page of check-runs and commit statuses at that exact head for ci-rollup; zero/error is pending, never success. Read diff paths for change-class (deny list wins). Fetch the exact issue body bytes; run body-sha without adding a newline. On first PIN find approval evidence ONLY with temporal_list_workflows limit:100 and query WorkflowType="UweDesignWorkflow" AND Repo="{{input.Repo}}" AND IssueNumber={{input.IssueNumber}} AND ExecutionStatus="Completed" AND ReviewRef="<BODY_SHA256>". Newest startTime first, call temporal_get_workflow_result for each row with workflow_id=<row.workflowId>, run_id=<row.runId>; save returned text verbatim and run acceptance_plan.py design-result --issue {{input.IssueNumber}} --workflow-id <row.workflowId> --run-id <row.runId> --result-file <file>. Only DESIGN_MATCH: yes counts. Every error, null, bare/old bridge result or mismatch means --design-match no in plan-evidence and PLAN_APPROVAL:none. Never fetch a result without run_id or follow a continued run. Hash canonical fenced Acceptance plan JSON, run plan-check. Compare against the in-run approved hash {{vars.approved_plan_sha256}}; no new run inherits an in-run approval. Read all receipt/comment pages, prior-rounds with PriorFixRounds={{input.PriorFixRounds | default: 'absent'}} / PriorBatchRounds={{input.PriorBatchRounds | default: 'absent'}}, prior-clean for EVERY earlier attempt of this run, and harness-evidence at the current head; malformed/error harness evidence is unknown. Validate owner enabled/running, not implementer/reviewer, all capabilities and existing prerequisites with access-check. Resolve an explicit 40-hex private-map commit, not an agent-image value: <capability map, see docs/pr-acceptance.md>. Record commit/hash and resolved SshTargets; missing map makes host access invalid, non-host items still evaluate. No grants, prerequisites, configuration, tools, instructions, definitions, production changes or deployments.
Return exactly these token lines: PR, HEAD_OID, IS_DRAFT, CI, CI_FAILING, CHANGE_CLASS, PLAN, PLAN_SHA256, MAX_DURATION, WAIT_SECONDS, PRE_STAGES, POST_STAGES, OWNER, PRIOR_RECEIPTS, PRIOR_ATTEMPTS_CLEAN, PRIOR_ROUNDS, PRIOR_LAST_HEAD, MAP_COMMIT, MAP_SHA256, SSH_TARGETS, PINNED_AT, BODY_SHA256, PLAN_APPROVAL, APPROVED_PLAN_SHA256, ACCEPTANCE_ISO, HARNESS_RETRY_SPENT. Tokens and meanings are those in docs/pr-acceptance.md; missing evidence is never ok.
Plan source: use the fenced issue-body plan. If that plan is absent and this run already has approved_plan_sha256={{vars.approved_plan_sha256}} from a bound CEO plan gate, read every comment page and select only the plan comment whose canonical JSON hash equals that exact approved hash; validate it and report PLAN_APPROVAL: gate. Never use an unapproved comment or inherit an earlier run gate. If a present body plan differs, report plan_changed rather than hiding it behind an old comment. The plan gate approves its displayed hash, not a subsequent read.

Newest startTime first, call temporal_get_workflow_result for each row with workflow_id=<row.workflowId>, run_id=<row.runId>; save returned text verbatim and run acceptance_plan.py design-result --issue {{input.IssueNumber}} --workflow-id <row.workflowId> --run-id <row.runId> --result-file <file>. Only DESIGN_MATCH: yes counts. Every error, null, bare/old bridge result or mismatch means --design-match no in plan-evidence and PLAN_APPROVAL:none. Never fetch a result without run_id or follow a continued run. Hash canonical fenced Acceptance plan JSON, run plan-check. Compare against the in-run approved hash {{vars.approved_plan_sha256}}; no new run inherits an in-run approval. Read all receipt/comment pages, prior-rounds with PriorFixRounds={{input.PriorFixRounds | default: 'absent'}} / PriorBatchRounds={{input.PriorBatchRounds | default: 'absent'}}, prior-clean for EVERY earlier attempt of this run, and harness-evidence at the current head; malformed/error harness evidence is unknown. Validate owner enabled/running, not implementer/reviewer, all capabilities and existing prerequisites with access-check. Resolve an explicit 40-hex private-map commit, not an agent-image value: <capability map, see docs/pr-acceptance.md>. Record commit/hash and resolved SshTargets; missing map makes host access invalid, non-host items still evaluate. No grants, prerequisites, configuration, tools, instructions, definitions, production changes or deployments.
Return exactly these token lines: PR, HEAD_OID, IS_DRAFT, CI, CI_FAILING, CHANGE_CLASS, PLAN, PLAN_SHA256, MAX_DURATION, WAIT_SECONDS, PRE_STAGES, POST_STAGES, OWNER, PRIOR_RECEIPTS, PRIOR_ATTEMPTS_CLEAN, PRIOR_ROUNDS, PRIOR_LAST_HEAD, MAP_COMMIT, MAP_SHA256, SSH_TARGETS, PINNED_AT, BODY_SHA256, PLAN_APPROVAL, APPROVED_PLAN_SHA256, ACCEPTANCE_ISO, HARNESS_RETRY_SPENT. Tokens and meanings are those in docs/pr-acceptance.md; missing evidence is never ok.
Plan source: use the fenced issue-body plan. If that plan is absent and this run already has approved_plan_sha256={{vars.approved_plan_sha256}} from a bound CEO plan gate, read every comment page and select only the plan comment whose canonical JSON hash equals that exact approved hash; validate it and report PLAN_APPROVAL: gate. Never use an unapproved comment or inherit an earlier run gate. If a present body plan differs, report plan_changed rather than hiding it behind an old comment. The plan gate approves its displayed hash, not a subsequent read.

args.Subject: Merge-gate feedback on PR for issue #{{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}} in {{input.Repo}}
args.ReviewPrompt:
Review the PR at {{vars.pr_url}} in repo {{input.Repo}}.

Merge-gate feedback requested changes before merging. It came through the merge-approval signal, which the CEO sends from the dashboard and the configured CTO agent may send as feedback; the payload does not say which.

Feedback comment:
{{vars.merge_decision.Comment | default: 'no specific comment'}}

Evaluate whether the feedback's concerns are valid and warrant code changes.
Implementation summary:
{{vars.impl_result}}

Prior review history:
{{vars.consensus_out.ConsolidatedReasoning | default: 'none'}}

Review discipline:
- Fetch the current spec/PR fresh — do NOT summarize prior rounds.
- Verify each prior finding against the current text before reporting.
- Give structured findings with severity (blocker, high, medium, low).
- End your response with exactly one verdict line: VERDICT: approved | changes_requested | needs_human_review.

EVIDENCE MIRROR (best-effort, optional).
Post your full technical review as a comment on that GitHub issue/PR, then put the resulting comment URL on your EVIDENCE: line.
- Before posting, remove private identities, internal IDs, hostnames, workflow-run identifiers, and private incident or configuration details. The repository may be public. Your unsanitized response is retained in durable workflow history regardless.
- If the GitHub CLI, auth, API, or the comment post fails for any reason, write `EVIDENCE: none`, mention the mirror failure in one short clause in SUMMARY:, and still return every BLOCKER: line and your VERDICT:. A failed mirror never downgrades or fails the review — durable history is the source of truth, the comment is a convenience copy.
- If you are continuing a response that was cut off and the earlier part already contains an `EVIDENCE: https://...` URL, reuse that URL and do NOT post a second comment.

notifyStep.name: notify_post_feedback_human_review
notifyStep.instruction:
Post to Telegram group: PR for issue #{{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}} in {{input.Repo}} ({{vars.pr_url}}) is paused for a human-review decision. The review of merge-gate feedback returned needs_human_review:
{{vars.ceo_consensus_out.ConsolidatedReasoning}}
Merge-gate feedback: {{vars.merge_decision.Comment | default: 'none'}}. The signal payload does not record who sent it; do not call it a CEO decision.
Send 'human-review': approved → fresh consensus review of the current head, then the separate merge-approval gate; changes_requested with a Comment → the implementer revises, then fresh review; rejected → the run ends and the PR stays open. No human-review decision merges the PR. This pause ends after 3 hours. Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.

steps.name: notify_post_feedback_human_review_timeout
steps.instruction: Post to Telegram group: PrImplementationWorkflow for issue #{{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}} in {{input.Repo}} ({{vars.pr_url}}) auto-cancelled: no human-review response after 3 hours following the merge-gate feedback review. The PR stays open. Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.

steps.name: notify_post_feedback_human_rejected
steps.instruction: Post to Telegram group: PR for issue #{{input.IssueNumber | default: 'N/A'}} in {{input.Repo}} ({{vars.pr_url}}) was rejected at the human-review pause after the merge-gate feedback review. The run ends and the PR stays open. Reason: {{vars.post_feedback_decision.Comment | default: 'no reason given'}} Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.

none.name: phase4_merge
none.instruction:
Merge the PR at {{vars.pr_url}} in repo {{input.Repo}}, pinned to the unanimously attested head {{vars.review_ref}}. If draft, run gh pr ready first. Run exactly:
gh pr merge {{vars.pr_url}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --squash --match-head-commit {{vars.review_ref}}

If it fails, do not retry or merge another way, bypass branch protection or rewrite branch history. Report the exact failure. Confirm only the actual merged state.
Return MERGE_RESULT: merged|head_changed|failed; a match-head refusal is head_changed, never retry.

default.name: phase4_merge_pinned
default.instruction:
Merge the PR at {{vars.pr_url}} in repo {{input.Repo}}, approved under an epic grant for the reviewed head {{vars.review_ref}}. Run exactly:
gh pr merge {{vars.pr_url}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --squash --match-head-commit {{vars.review_ref}}

If it fails (for example because the head moved after review), do NOT retry, rewrite branch history or merge any other way. Report the error. Confirm once merged.
Return MERGE_RESULT: merged|head_changed|failed.

steps.name: verify_merge_status
steps.instruction:
Verify whether the PR at {{vars.pr_url}} in repo {{input.Repo}} was actually merged. Run exactly:
gh pr view {{vars.pr_url}} --repo {{input.Repo}} --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit

(Never use a `merged` field: gh has no such JSON field and exits 1.)

Output the command's JSON verbatim on one line prefixed with `PR_STATE_JSON: `. If the command fails for any reason (non-zero exit, error text, no output), output exactly `PR_STATE_JSON: ERROR`. Do not decide whether it merged — the workflow reads the JSON. Put nothing else on a PR_STATE_JSON line.

steps.name: notify_merge_failed

default.name: notify_outer_loop_exhausted
default.instruction: The PR remains open: 60 delivery passes ended without a terminal decision. Manual continuation is required. Use 1–3 plain sentences with verified results, the next action and owner, and at most one exact human ask. No invented progress or signal-sending instructions.
